mapper.select: SELECT id AS mission_id, title, description, mission_type, trigger_event, target_count, reward_point, start_at, end_at, created_at FROM mission ORDER BY id
SELECT id AS mission_id, title, description, mission_type, trigger_event, target_count, reward_point, start_at, end_at, created_at FROM mission WHERE id = #{missionId}

SELECT mp.id AS user_mission_id, mp.user_id, mp.mission_id, mp.status, mp.current_count, mp.progress, mp.reward_received, m.target_count, m.title, m.description, m.reward_point FROM mission_progress mp JOIN mission m ON mp.mission_id = m.id WHERE mp.user_id = #{userId} AND mp.mission_id = #{missionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mission_progress (user_id, mission_id, status, current_count, progress) VALUES (#{userId}, #{missionId}, 'IN_PROGRESS', 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE mission_progress SET reward_received = TRUE, completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{userMissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_history (user_id, mission_id, point, reason, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{missionId}, #{rewardPoint}, #{reason}, NOW())

INSERT INTO mission (title, description, mission_type, trigger_event, target_count, reward_point, start_at, end_at) VALUES (#{title}, #{description}, #{missionType}, #{triggerEvent}, #{targetCount}, #{rewardPoint}, #{startAt}, #{endAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE mission SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, mission_type = #{missionType}, trigger_event = #{triggerEvent}, target_count = #{targetCount}, reward_point = #{rewardPoint}, start_at = #{startAt}, end_at = #{endAt} WHERE id = #{missionId}
